scope: Frozen U01-U12; 52 execution steps, not additional release gates
dependency_semantics: depends_on controls implementation readiness. A predecessor with implementation_done=true may unblock software work while its external/native validation remains BLOCKED. Final DONE requires the stated acceptance evidence; final product requires every applicable requirement plus independent review. Target checks are independent; no inferred native PASS.
